ecosystemFindings: ZERO consumers depend on the npm curt-format package — all five implement or vendor their own copy of the rules.
Only the dot_curt reference implements the 1.1.0 BOM rule; every consumer fails a BOM-prefixed file (porter only by accident of TextDecoder).
Nobody implements the documented curtFilename naming convention — three different sanitizers, none matching SPEC.md.
All copies are v1-strict on parse, which is the spec's most load-bearing rule — that part has held.
Version lineage is broken: porter's oracle pins curtis-ai-chat v2.0.1 (1c7a19f) but that repo now self-identifies as curtis@1.0.0.
